Mama Wheelies Ladies Group Ride

Portsmouth, NH · Road

Women / trans / femme

Mama Wheelies Ladies Group Ride is a road group ride in Portsmouth, NH. It rolls every Wednesday at 5:45 pm from Papa Wheelies Bicycle Shop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive.
Check
Look at @mamawheeliesnh the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Mama Wheelies Ladies Group Ride group ride

A weekly women's ride that meets at Papa Wheelies on Wednesday evenings and rolls at 5:45. Runs year-round. The group has its own Strava club and Instagram; email mamawheelies@gmail.com with questions.
